items.title: The Merrie History of Looney Tunes (Complete)
items.description: An eight-part Youtube documentary series created by KaiserBeamz, chronicling the history of the Looney Tunes cartoons, beginning with their inception in 1929 with the creation of Bosko, and ending with where the brand stands in the modern day (as of the release of the final part in December 2025).
